## Description

**What**: Populate the gov-copy domain partition of the UI/UX reference corpus with a Foundation federal-style-canon slice: USWDS forms copy guidance, GOV.UK error/form patterns and Service Manual writing for user interfaces, and VA.gov Content Style Guide (error anatomy, capitalization, punctuation).

**Why**: SC-8 requires federal-style-canon entries for the gov-copy domain, and the depending epic f360-3a5b-b8f3-4f86 (gov-copy-writer sub-agent) needs these three sources most immediately — they are the primary US government-facing form-copy references. The enhancement slice (18F, FPLG, CDC) ships separately to unblock the dependent epic sooner.

**Scope**:
- IN: gov-copy domain Markdown files for USWDS, GOV.UK, and VA.gov; stable rule_id per entry; prior_art citation URL and precedence field enforced at schema layer; docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml registration for all three sources with license confirmation
- OUT: 18F, FPLG, CDC entries (enhancement slice story); any other domain

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the gov-copy domain partition contains >=1 schema-valid entry per source for: USWDS forms copy guidance, GOV.UK error/form patterns + Service Manual writing for UI, and VA.gov Content Style Guide (error anatomy, capitalization, punctuation)
  <- Satisfies: sc-8  (sc-8: "Initial corpus includes federal-style-canon entries covering USWDS forms, GOV.UK error/form patterns, VA.gov Content Style Guide")
- When this story is complete, each gov-copy entry carries a stable rule_id, a prior_art citation URL, and a precedence field enforced at the schema layer by check-corpus-schema.sh
  <- Satisfies: sc-8  (sc-8: "each entry carries a stable rule ID, a prior-art citation, and a precedence field")
- When this story is complete, ref-query.sh gov-copy "error message" returns >=1 result with source attribution from USWDS, GOV.UK, or VA.gov
  <- Satisfies: sc-8
- When this story is complete, docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml registers USWDS, GOV.UK, and VA.gov entries with fields: name, url, type, access, license, and which corpus domains each populates
  <- Satisfies: sc-7  (provenance record for all corpus entries)
- When this story is complete, licensing is confirmed for all three sources (USWDS: public domain/CC0, GOV.UK: Open Government Licence, VA.gov: public domain) and documented in docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml
  <- Satisfies: sc-8  (licensing consideration from adversarial review)
- When this story is complete, the integration test suite at tests/integration/test-ref-library.sh passes including the precision sub-test for "USWDS form validation" returning a top result whose frontmatter tags match the expected-tag mapping
  <- Satisfies: sc-5  (precision sub-test (e))

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked.
